hero.title: SERVICES BUILT FOR BRANDS THAT NEED TO BE SEEN, HEARD, AND REMEMBERED.
hero.subtitle: Kuanzia design na print hadi photography, video, audio, digital campaigns, na studio training, Tripod Creative Agency hubadilisha ideas kuwa kazi iliyo tayari kwa production.

intro.title: Huduma zilizounganishwa
intro.body: Huduma 12 zimepangwa kama workflow moja, zikionyesha jinsi Tripod inaunganisha creative direction, capture, sound, print, na rollout support bila kuuvunja brief vipande vipande.

designBrand.title: DESIGN & BRAND
designBrand.body: Identity systems, campaign design, na surfaces tayari kwa print na rollout.

visualProduction.title: VISUAL PRODUCTION
visualProduction.body: Photography, video, drone work, na livestream delivery vinafanya kazi kama capture unit moja.

soundStudio.title: SOUND & STUDIO
soundStudio.body: Recording, music production, podcast sessions, na mafunzo ya vitendo yanakaa ndani ya studio environment moja.

digitalGrowth.title: DIGITAL GROWTH
digitalGrowth.body: Digital rollout inabaki imefungwa kwenye campaign badala ya kuwa afterthought tofauti.

graphicDesign.title: Graphic Design
graphicDesign.description: Campaign graphics, poster systems, na branded layouts tayari kwa matumizi.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Identity direction inayofanya brand iwe wazi na ikumbukwe.

printing.title: Printing
printing.description: Printed materials kwa events, campaigns, maduka, na launches.

photography.title: Photography
photography.description: Portrait, product, na event stills zinazorekodiwa kwa campaigns, content, na documentation.

videography.title: Videography
videography.description: Cinematic coverage, edits, na branded motion zinazojengwa kwa screens.

droneCoverage.title: Drone Coverage
droneCoverage.description: Aerial coverage inayopanua story na scale ya shoot.

liveStreaming.title: Live Streaming
liveStreaming.description: Multi-camera signal support kwa launches, events, na live moments.

audioRecording.title: Audio Recording
audioRecording.description: Voice, vocals, na studio recordings zenye clean signal na direction iliyo wazi.

musicProduction.title: Music Production
musicProduction.description: Beats, arrangement, na studio shaping vinavyojengwa kuzunguka final sound.

podcastRecording.title: Podcast Recording
podcastRecording.description: Voice-led sessions zenye studio setup inayoweka mazungumzo yakiwa safi.

digitalMarketing.title: Digital Marketing
digitalMarketing.description: Content planning na rollout support vinavyoisaidia campaign kuendelea baada ya production.

instrumentTraining.title: Instrument Training
instrumentTraining.description: Mafunzo ya vitendo yanayounganisha rehearsal, confidence, na nidhamu ya studio.

process.title: Brief hadi delivery
process.body: Hii inaonyesha jinsi Tripod inavyofanya kazi kwa vitendo: hatua wazi, handoff iliyoeleweka, na njia ya kutoka idea hadi delivery.

steps.title: Brief Lock
steps.description: Tunalinganisha message, audience, deliverables, na huduma zinazohitajika.

steps.title: Creative Direction
steps.description: References, formats, timing, na creative direction vinawekwa sawa kabla production haijaanza.

steps.title: Production / Design / Record
steps.description: Design, capture, printing, au studio sessions husogea kwa direction moja iliyoshirikishwa.

steps.title: Edit / Print / Package
steps.description: Assets zinaeditiwa, ku-exportiwa, kuchapishwa, au kupangiwa rollout.

steps.title: Launch / Deliver
steps.description: Kazi ya mwisho hukabidhiwa ikiwa tayari kwa posting, screening, printing, au launch.

digitalSupport.title: Campaign rollout support
digitalSupport.body: Ikiwa campaign inahitaji rollout support, content structuring, au landing-page assistance, Tripod inaweza kupanua production plan baada ya brief kuwa wazi.
digitalSupport.label: DIGITAL SUPPORT

cta.title: LETA MRADI WAKO UNAOFUATA TRIPOD.
cta.body: Anza kwa WhatsApp na service moja, production zone moja, au brief nzima na tutakuongoza kwenye workflow sahihi.

featuredDevelopment.title: ONE BRIEF. MULTIPLE DISCIPLINES.
featuredDevelopment.description: Campaign moja inaweza kuhitaji design, stills, video, live coverage, audio, na rollout assets. Hapa Tripod Creative Agency hufanya kazi kama production desk moja badala ya suppliers waliogawanyika.
